Name: Flexible Cooking Ingredients for Wildflour's Atelier Goods (WAG)
Author: zombifier
Description:
This mod makes it so cooking recipes from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour's Atelier Goods[/url], and optionally the add-on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18717]HxW Mixology 101[/url] can accept a wider variety of ingredients, such as extra types of lemons, limes, olive oils, basils, or lavenders added by another mod such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url], instead of strictly WAG's own version of these items.

To install, unzip into the Mods folder as usual. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url] and WAG is required; HxW mixology is optional.

Also check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38862]Flexible Cooking[/url] from 6480! A good companion for if you want flexible ingredients to also apply to vanilla recipes.
